lessons_used: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.

No clear effect was seen for spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders, desktop diagnostic flows, playful starter hubs, carousel path layouts, desktop overlay waiting hints, account persistence verification, desktop visibility prompts, and estimated generation time indicators.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, and path choice flexibility reassurance copy performed worse than control.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, pre-adoption photo prep screens, and all changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.

candidates.title: Split Layout Quick Companion Setup View
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro screen into a split view with live desktop placement previews and quick sound controls.
candidates.why: The finish step has a low 64.8% conversion rate and support received multiple inquiries regarding how to control or interact with the pet post-onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your New Desktop Companion
home_intro.body: Your pet is now active on your desktop! Test sound effects and quick controls below.

guard.reason: 'home_intro.replace.home_welcome[0]': a preview cannot do the home_welcome job (use ['animation', 'button', 'checklist', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'])

candidates.title: Pet Naming Companion Creation Screen
candidates.change: Inserts a dedicated companion naming screen right before the adoption certificate generation step.
candidates.why: Adoption has a 75.3% conversion rate and takes a median of 89s; giving the pet a name early increases user attachment.

new_pet_naming.headline: Name Your Companion
new_pet_naming.body: Choose a unique name for your pet before finalizing their adoption certificate.

guard.reason: Valid addition of a companion naming screen to onboarding flow.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops ~25% users, but adding pre-adoption screens extra steps historically shows minimal gain (+0.7%).

candidates.title: Companion Archetype Quick Selector Flow
candidates.change: Adds an archetype preference screen before path selection to help users choose between custom or pre-made pet styles.
candidates.why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s; filtering options by archetype accelerates user choice.

new_archetype_selector.headline: What Kind of Companion Do You Want?
new_archetype_selector.body: Select a personality archetype to filter the best path for you.

guard.reason: Valid addition of an archetype selector screen before path choice.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high choice duration (514s); pet style and archetype selectors previously beat predictions.

candidates.title: Account Session Safeguard Gateway View
candidates.change: Inserts a sign-in gateway view emphasizing cloud backup so users understand why signing in protects their companion.
candidates.why: 8 support emails noted pets missing or reset after signing in again, and sign-in drop-off is 78.3%.

new_sign_in_gateway.headline: Safeguard Your Companion
new_sign_in_gateway.body: Signing in links your pet's personality and progress to your account so you never lose them.

guard.reason: screen 'new_sign_in_gateway' is not part of onboarding (new screens are named new_..., and may not look like payment, account, sign-up or settings screens)

candidates.title: Pet Activity Sneak Peek Sound Carousel
candidates.change: Adds an audio and activity preview component to the waiting screen during generation.
candidates.why: The waiting phase has a long mean time of 2336s; interactive previews maintain user engagement while waiting.

components.text: Your pet will interact with your cursor and desktop windows once ready.

guard.reason: Valid addition of audio and tips to waiting screen while retaining its core function.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 13.6% with long 2336s wait; wait_info changes consistently average around +3.1% lift.

candidates.title: Multi-Angle Photo Selection Helper Badge
candidates.change: Adds visual photo style guidance badges on the photo upload screen.
candidates.why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong, contributing to adoption drop-offs.

upload_photos.hint: For best results, upload high-resolution photos with clear lighting.

guard.reason: Asks for personal information (photos of user)

candidates.title: Desktop Dock Placement Guidance Banner
candidates.change: Updates the home intro screen copy with clear instructions on finding the pet on the desktop or tray.
candidates.why: 3 support tickets noted pets not showing on the desktop or failing to open, while finish conversion is 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Your Pet is Live on Your Screen!
home_intro.body: Look for your companion on your desktop or in the system tray to control, show, or hide them.
home_intro.hint: If your pet disappears, click the system tray icon to bring them back to the front.

guard.reason: Valid copy and hint update for home_intro screen.

candidates.score_note: High impact step (35.2% loss) with support ticket evidence, but finish copy changes previously degraded conversion.

candidates.title: Account Persistence Benefits Card Layout
candidates.change: Replaces sign-in options with a card layout that explicitly highlights pet data preservation.
candidates.why: 8 users reported pets missing/reset after re-signing in, causing friction at the sign_in step (78.3% conversion).

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Protect Your Pet
sign_in.body: Your account links your custom companion to cloud storage so your pet is always preserved.

guard.reason: 'sign_in.replace.sign_in_options[0]': a badge cannot do the sign_in_options job (use ['button', 'choice_cards', 'image', 'text'])

candidates.title: Immersive Companion Introduction Story Card
candidates.change: Revises story screen intro copy to set clear expectations on what desktop pets do before path choice.
candidates.why: Choose path takes a mean duration of 514s; framing user expectations early reduces initial hesitation.

story.headline: Welcome to Your Desktop Companion
story.body: Create or choose an interactive virtual pet that lives right on your desktop while you work.

guard.reason: Valid copy update that continues to introduce the pet on the story screen.

candidates.score_note: Framing/reassurance copy on path selection screens previously performed worse than control (-2.8%).

candidates.title: Interactive Companion Hatching Progress Bar
candidates.change: Displays an animated hatching progress bar and pet sprite preview on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: The waiting step has a high mean duration of 2336s; visual progress feedback keeps users from quitting during background rendering.

guard.reason: Valid addition of progress animation to waiting screen.

candidates.score_note: Interactive progress displays strongly align with lessons where progress carousels boosted engagement during rendering.

lessons_next: Helpful changes: Preset fast-track adoption flows, moving sign-in right after pet adoption, photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.

No clear effect: Spotlight welcome layouts, background notification prompts, account sync banners, subsequent sign-in reorders/flows, desktop diagnostic flows, starter hubs, carousel path layouts, waiting hints/indicators, visibility prompts, archetype selector flows, and hatching progress bars.
Worse performance: Pre-adoption photo prep screens, path decision speed helper callouts, path choice flexibility reassurance copy, and desktop dock placement guidance banners.
Predictions were too low for photo quality assistant callouts, interactive progress carousels, split-view path selection screens, and custom pet style selector views.
Predictions were too high for preset fast-track adoption flows, sign-in reordering, and all changes that showed no clear effect or performed worse.
